name: Himura Kazuki
source:
Kazuki is the male protagonist. He has recently returned to the place of his birth, Kimikage Island, and transferred into Himeyuri Academy. His mother died in a major island-wide disaster when he was little, but he doesn't have memories from that far back. His family belongs to an ancient clan of the island, though he has little interest in said matters.

[From [url=https://gamicus.fandom.com/wiki/SchoolMate]Codex Gamicus[/url]]
